notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1): $poolManager resolves to 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90; $token resolves to the newly deployed SIMDTEST. The hook constructor takes these two arguments in that order. SIMDTEST has no constructor arguments and uses standard ERC20 transfers without taxes, including transfers to PoolManager. Deploy SIMDTESTHook directly at a CREATE2-mined address whose low 14 bits equal 0x20cc. All enabled callbacks accept only PoolManager. beforeInitialize binds the single pool with this hook, SIMDTEST, IMD, fee 12500 and tickSpacing 60, recording the opening block and initial batch timestamp. It accepts the factory's opening price; initialPrice is decimal sqrtPriceX96 for provenance, while launch economics determine the actual opening price. Hook fees use beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas on top of the static 1.25% LP fee, without dynamic fees or LP fee overrides. Anti-snipe starts at 30% in opening block B, decreases 3 percentage points per block and reaches zero at B+10. Liquidity growth remains 0.5%; the maximum combined hook rate is 30.5%. Both fees apply only to gross IMD: total trader input on buys and pre-hook-fee pool output on sells. Exact-output paths gross up net IMD using the combined rate; each reserve rounds down separately. Specified-side partial fills use a rollback-only quote and charge the executed share; unspecified-side fees use actual pool deltas. Fees accrue as IMD ERC-6909 claims held by the hook, avoiding immediate currency withdrawals during swaps. Anyone may call sweep() to redeem anti-snipe claims to 0x3dd5f73dd1a4e62630fad3909673f130ad429985, capped per call at int128.max with any excess retained. Anyone may call donateBatch() after 3600 seconds from initialization or the last successful batch. It donates min(floor(pending()/2), int128.max), burning growth claims to settle PoolManager.donate. Empty or failed donations preserve the reserve and timer. pending() and lastBatch() expose these values. Donations reward currently in-range LPs and create no LP position. A same-transaction JIT position can capture almost all of a batch, or all less rounding as the sole in-range LP; no historical-LP eligibility or holding period is enforced. No currency conversion, underlying-token burning, owner, admin, setters, proxy or upgradeability exists. Live mainnet-fork tests are opt-in and skipped by the default offline suite; an offline pass does not establish live-fork validation.
